using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Volo.Abp.Authorization;

public interface IPermissionChecker
{
    Task<PermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string permissionName);

    Task<PermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string permissionName, string userId);

    Task<Dictionary<string, PermissionGrantResult>> IsGrantedAsync(string[] permissionNames);

    Task<Dictionary<string, PermissionGrantResult>> IsGrantedAsync(string[] permissionNames, string userId);
}

public class PermissionGrantResult
{
    public bool IsGranted { get; }

    public PermissionGrantResult(bool isGranted)
    {
        IsGranted = isGranted;
    }

    public static PermissionGrantResult Granted => new PermissionGrantResult(true);

    public static PermissionGrantResult NotGranted => new PermissionGrantResult(false);
}

public class PermissionGrantResult<TData>
{
    public bool IsGranted { get; }

    public TData Data { get; }

    public PermissionGrantResult(bool isGranted, TData data)
    {
        IsGranted = isGranted;
        Data = data;
    }

    public static PermissionGrantResult<TData> Granted(TData data) => new PermissionGrantResult<TData>(true, data);

    public static PermissionGrantResult<TData> NotGranted(TData data) => new PermissionGrantResult<TData>(false, data);
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;

namespace Volo.Abp.SimpleStateChecking;

public class SimpleStateCheckerContext<TState>
{
    public TState State { get; }

    public IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; }

    public SimpleStateCheckerContext(TState state, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        State = state;
        ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }
}

using Moq;
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Authorization.Permissions;
using Volo.Abp.SimpleStateChecking;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Authorization.Tests
{
    public class RequirePermissionsSimpleStateCheckerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task IsEnabledAsync_PermissionGranted_ReturnsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var permissionCheckerMock = new Mock<IPermissionChecker>();
            permissionCheckerMock.Setup(pc => pc.IsGrantedAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(PermissionGrantResult.Granted);

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IPermissionChecker>()).Returns(permissionCheckerMock.Object);

            var context = new SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>(new object(), serviceProviderMock.Object);
            var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(new object(), new[] { "TestPermission" });
            var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

            // Act
            var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(context);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task IsEnabledAsync_PermissionNotGranted_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var permissionCheckerMock = new Mock<IPermissionChecker>();
            permissionCheckerMock.Setup(pc => pc.IsGrantedAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(PermissionGrantResult.NotGranted);

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IPermissionChecker>()).Returns(permissionCheckerMock.Object);

            var context = new SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>(new object(), serviceProviderMock.Object);
            var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(new object(), new[] { "TestPermission" });
            var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

            // Act
            var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(context);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }
    }
}
